_doc: Phase 3d body proportions by position (render/playerMesh.ts setBuild). width / depth scale torso, waist and shoulder pads; belly 0..1 adds a gut in front of the waist; thigh scales thigh thickness; arm scales arm thickness and pushes the shoulders out with the width; legs scales leg length (the hips sit lower); height scales the whole figure. Linemen are broad, deep-chested and heavy-legged with shorter legs relative to their frame; receivers and corners are lean. Unlisted positions use 1 everywhere.
